title: Evening OPay settlement check
summary: Every evening, add up what OPay took today, the fees and what was settled to you, and tell the owner with the account balance.
description: Every day at the time you choose, reads today's OPay payments from your POS sales table (kept by the OPay recording workflow), adds up the amounts taken, OPay's fees and the amounts settled to you, asks OPay for the account balance, and sends the owner one message with the figures. This is the gross-against-net check: what customers paid, what OPay kept, what reached you. The owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the check is sent, Lagos time.

params.name: table
params.title: POS sales table
params.description: The table the recording workflows write to.

params.name: opay_connection
params.title: OPay Business connection
params.description: The OPay Business connection to ask.

tables.name: {{table}}
tables.title: POS sales
tables.description: Every transaction your terminals make, one row per event the provider sends. Amounts are in naira; fee and settled are filled when the provider reports them (OPay does, Moniepoint does not).

definition.name: Evening OPay settlement check
definition.description: Gross taken, fees and settled today, with the OPay balance, to the owner.

steps.name: Work out today's date in Lagos
Read today's OPay payments from the POS sales table
Ask OPay for the account balance
Add up taken, fees and settled
Tell the owner the settlement figures

input.title: OPay settlement
input.message: =has(steps.totals.output.message) ? steps.totals.output.message : steps.settings.output.business_name + ' OPay settlement: today\'s figures could not be added up.'
